baseline_note: All methods share legal sum semantics. temporal_filter_exact reuses a charged snapshot. uncertified_hierarchy ignores epsilon. Compare total write+rolling queries, not query scans alone. RSS includes interpreter/allocator and is not isolated index memory.

sizes.construction_note: Memory is a separate traced pass. Timing replays seeded generation+writes without tracing, in the same warmed process; not independent fresh-process cold samples.
